data.name: New Engineer Onboarding
data.description: Foundational learning path for new engineering hires. Covers TypeScript fundamentals, system design basics, code-review practices, CI/CD tooling, cross-functional collaboration, and incident response basics. Typically completed in the first 12 weeks of employment.

data.name: Senior Engineer Track
data.description: Curated path for engineers progressing toward Senior level. Emphasizes advanced system design, Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipeline ownership, incident-response leadership, mentoring, and domain architecture. Typically completed over two quarters.

data.name: Tech Lead Track
data.description: Path for individual contributors transitioning into technical leadership. Combines architectural rigor with stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, and code-review craft. Designed to prepare ICs for Tech Lead and Principal roles without requiring people management.

data.name: Site Reliability Engineer Track
data.description: Specialized track for engineers joining or transitioning to Site Reliability. Focuses on Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipeline reliability, incident response, observability standards, and on-call rotation practices. Usually paired with shadowing on the SRE team.

data.name: Manager Transition Track
data.description: Path for senior individual contributors moving into people management. Centers on stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, mentoring craft, and the leadership skills needed to coach engineers. Currently in draft pending content review.

data.name: Legacy Architecture Refresh
data.description: Archived deep-dive into the legacy architecture deprecated in 2025. Retained for historical reference; new enrollments are disabled. Contains modules on the previous service decomposition pattern and the internal frameworks that have since been replaced.
